description: Persistent, verified memory for AI coding agents: recall, capture, guardrails, review queue.
name: io.github.AiDimag/aidimag

environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the git repository whose memory store to serve. Optional: defaults to walking up from the current working directory.
environmentVariables.name: AIDIMAG_REPO

environmentVariables.description: LLM provider for extraction features (chat_harvest, knowledge ingestion): openai | ollama | off. Optional: auto-detected.
environmentVariables.name: AIDIMAG_LLM

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key, used only if the OpenAI provider is selected/detected for extraction features.
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY

packageArguments.description: Start the aidimag MCP server over stdio
